description:
Autex Quietspace Lattice - Torus is an architectural suspended acoustic baffle
sculpture featuring an abstract, circular woven form. Built from a grid of
intersecting 12mm semi-rigid Cube acoustic fins, its open geometry covers a
greater surface area than traditional parallel baffle systems to effectively
absorb echo and reverberation. Supplied flat-packed with a dedicated suspension
kit, Torus provides Class A acoustic performance (NRC 1.00 / up to 3.90 Sabins
per unit) and Group 1 fire safety for commercial, educational, and hospitality
interiors.

rag_summary:
Autex Quietspace Lattice - Torus is a suspended circular 3D
acoustic baffle sculpture measuring 1450mm x 1450mm x 293mm, constructed from
intersecting 12mm Cube polyester felt fins. By maximizing surface area exposure
to incident sound, it delivers Class A absorption (NRC 1.00 / 1.60 - 3.90 Sabins
per unit) to control echo and speech noise in open-ceiling spaces. Formed
from 100% polyester with at least 80% recycled PET and achieving Group 1 fire
compliance, it provides an expressive, carbon-neutral acoustic ceiling feature
for commercial, civic, and hospitality interiors.

description:

dedicated 4-point suspension kit, Trapezium delivers Class A acoustic
performance (NRC 1.00 / 1.60 - 3.90 Sabins per unit) and Group 1 fire safety for
open ceilings.

description:

nude or overlaid with decorative fabric to resolve severe reverberation across
walls and ceilings.

description:

rag_summary:
Autex Surface Finishes Frontier Raft - Beam (including Acoustic
Timber Raft Beam) is an acoustic ceiling beam system that combines
high-definition digitally printed timber grains and stone textures with hollow
sound-absorbing profiles (Beam 100 at 87mm and Beam 250 at 227mm depth).
Constructed from 12mm Cube polyester felt with an internal air gap and aluminium
suspension track, it delivers superior sound absorption (NRC 0.75 to 0.95) while
eliminating the weight, warping, and fire hazards of real wood beams. Rated
Group 1 fire compliant under AS ISO 9705 and certified carbon neutral with
over 60% recycled PET, it provides a warm, lifelike timber ceiling feature for
commercial and educational spaces.
